method: Seconds per pass = beats per pass x 60 / tempo. Each step lasts passes per step x seconds per pass, and the rest time is added between steps. The ladder starts at the start tempo, rises by the step size while staying below the target, and always ends exactly on the target; if the range does not divide evenly the final step is shorter than the step size. Up to 60 steps are planned. The target must be at least the start tempo, so the ladder only ramps up. Tempos are used exactly as entered. The plan is a practice schedule: it neither plays a metronome nor uses audio, storage or the network.
